title: Color the Carpet
statementMd:
Even polar bears feel cold when lying on the ice. Therefore, a polar bear Alice is going to make a carpet. The carpet can be viewed as a grid with height $*h*$ and width $*w*$. Then the grid is divided into $*h* × *w*$ squares. Alice is going to assign one of $*k*$ different colors to each square. The colors are numbered from 1 to $*k*$. She may choose not to use all of the colors.

However, there are some restrictions. For every two adjacent squares (squares that shares an edge) $*x*$ and $*y*$, there is a *color constraint* in one of the forms:

- $*color*(*x*) = *color*(*y*)$, or
- $*color*(*x*) ≠ *color*(*y*)$.

Example of the color constraints:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fce8f20ad1af5214f9a09484c54a56cd43b16e6b.png)

Ideally, Alice wants to satisfy all color constraints. But again, life in the Arctic is hard. It is not always possible to satisfy all color constraints. Fortunately, she will still be happy if at least ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9f39c6143dd624f0929d3babdfbb5bf8b5c45d6e.png) of the color constraints are satisfied.

If she has $4$ colors she can color the carpet in the following way:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/766239b0dde31cc790d0917c2aeee56de29ea0b6.png)

And she is happy because ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/07efd5da4ab82227b92fedbb5166e1781ca19047.png) of the color constraints are satisfied, and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/06df8fb560d1cc9566499a5a6c7f11bb8ed41486.png). Your task is to help her color the carpet.

## Input

The first line contains three integers $*h*, *w*, *k*$ $(2 ≤ *h*, *w* ≤ 1000, 1 ≤ *k* ≤ *w*·*h*)$.

The next $2*h* - 1$ lines describe the color constraints from top to bottom, left to right. They contain $*w* - 1, *w*, *w* - 1, *w*, ..., *w* - 1$ characters respectively. Each color constraint is represented by a character "`E`" or "`N`", where "`E`" means "$=$" and "`N`" means "$≠$".

The color constraints listed in the order they are depicted on the picture.

## Output

If there is a coloring that satisfies at least ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9f39c6143dd624f0929d3babdfbb5bf8b5c45d6e.png) of the color constraints, print "`YES`" (without quotes) in the first line. In each of the next $*h*$ lines, print $*w*$ integers describing the coloring.

Otherwise, print "`NO`" (without quotes).
statementZhMd:
即使是北极熊躺在冰面上也会感到寒冷。因此，北极熊 Alice 打算制作一张地毯。地毯可以看作一个高为 $*h*$、宽为 $*w*$ 的网格。该网格被划分为 $*h* × *w*$ 个方格。Alice 打算为每个方格指定 $*k*$ 种不同颜色中的一种。颜色编号为 1 到 $*k*$。她可以选择不使用所有颜色。

然而，这里有一些限制。对于每一对相邻的方格（共享一条边的方格）$*x*$ 和 $*y*$，存在以下形式之一的*颜色限制*：

- $*color*(*x*) = *color*(*y*)$，或
- $*color*(*x*) ≠ *color*(*y*)$。

颜色限制的示例：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fce8f20ad1af5214f9a09484c54a56cd43b16e6b.png)

理想情况下，Alice 希望满足所有颜色限制。但北极的生活依然艰苦，并非总能满足所有颜色限制。幸运的是，只要至少有 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9f39c6143dd624f0929d3babdfbb5bf8b5c45d6e.png) 的颜色限制得到满足，她就会感到满意。

如果她有 $4$ 种颜色，可以按照如下方式为地毯染色：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/766239b0dde31cc790d0917c2aeee56de29ea0b6.png)

她会感到满意，因为有 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/07efd5da4ab82227b92fedbb5166e1781ca19047.png) 的颜色限制得到满足，并且 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/06df8fb560d1cc9566499a5a6c7f11bb8ed41486.png)。你的任务是帮助她为地毯染色。

## 输入格式

第一行包含三个整数 $*h*, *w*, *k*$ $(2 ≤ *h*, *w* ≤ 1000, 1 ≤ *k* ≤ *w*·*h*)$。

接下来的 $2*h* - 1$ 行从上到下、从左到右描述颜色限制。它们分别包含 $*w* - 1, *w*, *w* - 1, *w*, ..., *w* - 1$ 个字符。每个颜色限制由字符 "`E`" 或 "`N`" 表示，其中 "`E`" 表示 "$=$"，而 "`N`" 表示 "$≠$"。

颜色限制的排列顺序与图片中的顺序一致。

## 输出格式

如果存在一种染色方案，使得至少有 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9f39c6143dd624f0929d3babdfbb5bf8b5c45d6e.png) 的颜色限制得到满足，则在第一行输出 "`YES`"（不含引号）。接下来的 $*h*$ 行中，每行输出 $*w*$ 个整数，描述染色结果。

否则，输出 "`NO`"（不含引号）。
